    ZarrSparseMatrixSeed objects

    ZarrSparseMatrixSeed.Rd

    ZarrSparseMatrixSeed is a low-level helper class for representing a pointer to a sparse matrix stored in a Zarr group in CSR or CSC layout, as three 1D arrays data, indices and indptr (e.g. the X group of an AnnData .zarr store). It is the Zarr counterpart of HDF5Array::H5SparseMatrixSeed.

    Arguments

    object, x

    A ZarrSparseMatrixSeed object.

    filepath

    Path to the .zarr store.

    group

    Name of the group in the store that contains the sparse matrix, e.g. "X".

    subdata

    Name of the array in group to use instead of "data" (e.g. a layer of alternative values that share the same indices and indptr). NULL means "data".

    dim

    Dimensions of the matrix (c(nrow, ncol)). By default they are read from the shape array or attribute of group.

    sparse.layout

    "CSR" or "CSC". By default it is read from the encoding-type (or h5sparse_format) attribute of group, falling back to "CSR".

    dimnames

    Optional list of 2 elements: row names and column names.

    index

    A list of 2 elements (NULL or integer vector), as for S4Arrays::extract_array().

    Value

    A CSC_ZarrSparseMatrixSeed or CSR_ZarrSparseMatrixSeed object.

    Details

    Note that a ZarrSparseMatrixSeed object is not intended to be used directly. Most end users will typically create and manipulate a higher-level ZarrSparseMatrix object instead.

    See also

    ZarrSparseMatrix

    Examples

    store <- system.file("extdata", "example.zarr",
                     package="ZarrSparseMatrix")
seed <- ZarrSparseMatrixSeed(store, "X")
seed
#> <200 x 100> sparse CSR_ZarrSparseMatrixSeed object of type "integer":
#> # dirname: /private/var/folders/7_/sqg9z3y97xd51lj4lml82n2w0000gn/T/RtmpyluTkR/temp_libpath1160a7bfcf51e/ZarrSparseMatrix/extdata
#> # basename: example.zarr
#> # group: X
dim(seed)
#> [1] 200 100
nzcount(seed)
#> [1] 6090
extract_array(seed, list(1:3, 1:5))
#>      [,1] [,2] [,3] [,4] [,5]
#> [1,]   11    0    0    1    0
#> [2,]    1    0    0    2    1
#> [3,]    0    0    2    2    0

## A CSR seed transposes to a CSC seed without reading any data
t(seed)
#> <100 x 200> sparse CSC_ZarrSparseMatrixSeed object of type "integer":
#> # dirname: /private/var/folders/7_/sqg9z3y97xd51lj4lml82n2w0000gn/T/RtmpyluTkR/temp_libpath1160a7bfcf51e/ZarrSparseMatrix/extdata
#> # basename: example.zarr
#> # group: X
